scope: Dormant Operational Ingress Verification Readiness Audit

readinessDistinction.explanation: Resource existence in Cloudflare Zero Trust does not equal ingress readiness. Ingress requires DNS routing, Worker route binding, non-secret env vars, human allow policy, identity registry enrollment, and barrier unblocking.

identifiedPrerequisites: Creation of exact DNS record ops.velnar.studio (LANE E)
Creation of dedicated Worker route ops.velnar.studio/* (LANE E)
Provisioning of non-secret Worker variables CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD (LANE C)
Creation of single deny-by-default human Access Allow policy (LANE D)
Enrollment of verified human operator email and Access subject into PRODUCTION_OPERATIONAL_SUPERADMIN_REGISTRY (LANE D)
Worker deployment with updated registry and configuration (LANE C)
Verification of CF-Access-JWT-Assertion resolution across all failure modes (LANE D/G)
Controlled unblocking of PRODUCTION_CANARY_OPERATIONAL_ROUTE_ENABLED and INGRESS_AUTH_READY (LANE G)

futureMutationPlan.step1_dnsProvisioning: Create CNAME ops.velnar.studio pointing to Worker host under active velnar.studio zone
futureMutationPlan.step2_workerRouteBinding: Configure Worker route ops.velnar.studio/api/ops/canary/deepseek-certification in wrangler.jsonc / dashboard
futureMutationPlan.step4_accessAllowPolicy: Create single policy: name="VELNAR Human Superadmin Allow", decision="allow", include: exact human operator email
futureMutationPlan.step6_ingressValidation: Execute structured negative test matrix (missing JWT, invalid sig, expired, wrong AUD, wrong subject, wrong email)
futureMutationPlan.step7_ingressCertification: Record cryptographic verification of live assertion without enabling live DeepSeek canary transport

rollbackPlan.dnsRollback: Delete CNAME ops.velnar.studio immediately stops ingress traffic at authoritative DNS
rollbackPlan.policyRollback: Delete human Allow policy immediately restores deny-all posture on Cloudflare Access
rollbackPlan.configRollback: Remove CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_AUD and CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN from Worker
rollbackPlan.registryRollback: Revert code commit to restore empty superadmin registry Object.freeze([])
